Node Links pane: Paste/Copy, Open File/Load URL/Download toolbar, one-link-per-line textarea, To sing-box Config button

evidence.note: Multi-line outlined textarea holding sing-box JSON; placeholder explains accepted formats; plain text, no syntax colouring
Multi-line textarea of node links; heading label 'Node Links (One per line)'
evidence.quote: One node link per line (ss:// vmess:// vless:// trojan:// etc.)

evidence.note: Config Type radio group in a bordered box; switching it immediately retitles the pane and reveals an engine switch and output-format radios on the right (verified live)
Open File button loads a local file into the textarea; Load URL reveals an inline URL field with Fetch (verified live); Paste button too

patterns.rationale: Two side-by-side fixed panes (source and converted output) share the window, but there is no resize divider; may be considered a plain two-column layout instead.

evidence.note: Config pane and Node Links pane side by side, each its own editable view of the same proxy set
Convert buttons transform text rather than submitting a set of labelled fields
JSON is in a plain proportional-font textarea with no gutter, syntax colouring or folding
Language button toggles English/Chinese directly (verified live), no menu opens

structure.layout: single-screen two-column converter tool: blue title bar, left config pane and right node-links pane each with Paste/Copy, an Open File/Load URL/Download toolbar and a large textarea, a full-width convert button under each pane, centered footer

aesthetics.typography: Segoe UI throughout (Fluent UI defaults): bold for the title and pane headings, semibold for buttons, regular for textarea content and toolbar labels
aesthetics.typeScale: 32px bold app title in header, 24px semibold pane headings with 12px parenthetical hint, 16px semibold primary convert buttons, 14px body/textarea/buttons, 12px toolbar subtle buttons and footer

notes: Built with Microsoft Fluent UI v9 (Segoe UI, #0f6cbd brand blue, 4px radii, #d1d1d1 strokes). Symmetrical source/target layout: each pane has secondary Paste + primary Copy buttons top-right, a row of subtle icon+text buttons (Open File, Load URL, Download), a large textarea, and a full-width brand-blue convert button with directional arrow (To Node Link ->, <- To sing-box Config). Selecting Clash (Mihomo) adds a js-yaml engine card with a switch and an output-format radio group (proxies / payload / no prefix) to the right pane. Header has only icon buttons for language (EN/zh toggle) and dark theme. Textareas scroll internally.
